dj-wdoof.l3: Traffic on the Strand is terrible, mostly because of you. Keep it up. We love the content.

dj-wdoof.l8: The doofus of the hour is you. Do not let it go to your head. Radio for Doofuses.

dj-lowtide.i1: This is Low Tide. We are somewhere on the dial. Probably.
dj-lowtide.l2: That was a slow one. They are all slow. The tide goes out, the tide comes in, and nobody files a form about it. Low Tide F M.
dj-lowtide.l3: The weather is... wet. Or it will be. Or it was. We will check the harbor, and get back to you in about an hour.
dj-lowtide.l4: If you are driving, please feel the road. If you are not driving, please feel your couch. Both are good. Low Tide.
dj-lowtide.l5: Next up, more of the same, but quieter. You are listening to eighty-eight point one, more or less.
dj-lowtide.l6: Somewhere a gull is thinking about something. We respect that. Low Tide F M.
dj-lowtide.l7: Take a breath. In. Out. In, a little. Good. That is all the exercise we have for you. Low Tide.
dj-lowtide.l8: The harbor is calm, and so are we. Mostly because we have not looked at the schedule.

dj-ledger.i1: You are tuned to Ledger ten-forty. Please keep your receipts.
dj-ledger.l2: That was track four, filed under smooth. Ledger ten-forty, music to file by.
dj-ledger.l3: A reminder: quarterly estimates are due whenever you remember them. Ledger ten-forty.
dj-ledger.l4: Please hold while we reclassify that song as a deduction. Thank you. Ledger ten-forty.
dj-ledger.l5: Our next selection is in triplicate. One copy for you, one for the harbor, one for the file. Ledger ten-forty.
dj-ledger.l6: The following song has been audited and found to be adequate. Ledger ten-forty.
dj-ledger.l7: Reminder: the deadline was yesterday. Fortunately, so was the extension. Ledger ten-forty.
dj-ledger.l8: Please enjoy this brief interlude, itemized as music, under miscellaneous. Ledger ten-forty.

dj-cannery.l2: Break's over, back on the line. That was funk, the kind with a safety guard. The Cannery, eighty-eight.
dj-cannery.l3: Shout out to the night shift, the only people who know what the moon does all day. Cannery eighty-eight.
dj-cannery.l4: If you work the belt, wave. If you are the belt, we understand. The Cannery, eighty-eight.
dj-cannery.l5: That's the whistle. The sound of a pension, somewhere, not happening. Keep it funky, and keep it clocked in.
dj-cannery.l6: That is the sound of the second shift clocking in, slightly late, and slightly funky. The Cannery, eighty-eight.
dj-cannery.l7: Supervisors, please remember: dancing is not a safety violation. Probably. The Cannery, eighty-eight.
dj-cannery.l8: Forklift of the week goes to forklift number three. Nobody asked. The Cannery, eighty-eight.

dj-fishbone.i0: Radio Fishbone. Old town, old tunes.
dj-fishbone.i1: This is Radio Fishbone, on the air since before the air.
dj-fishbone.l2: That was a waltz, as they were in my day, which was a Tuesday. Radio Fishbone.
dj-fishbone.l3: Please do not request anything newer than the lighthouse. Radio Fishbone, old town, old tunes.
dj-fishbone.l4: Back in the old days we only had three rules, and nobody can remember two of them. Radio Fishbone.
dj-fishbone.l5: That tune was written by a man who is now a bench. Radio Fishbone, old town, old tunes.
dj-fishbone.l6: Radio Fishbone, where the tunes are old, the jokes are older, and the transmitter is held up by string.
dj-fishbone.l7: If you remember this song, you are too old to be driving. Radio Fishbone, old town, old tunes.
dj-fishbone.l8: That was a sea shanty. The sea has since asked us to stop. Radio Fishbone.

dj-wtpd.i0: W T P D, six-ten A M. The lukewarm sound of Tepid Falls.
dj-wtpd.i1: Six-ten on your A M dial. Tepid Falls: not too hot, not too cold.
dj-wtpd.l2: That was the organ. We only have the one. W T P D, six-ten A M.
dj-wtpd.l3: Out in Tepid Falls the river is running at a pleasant, medium speed. Back after this chord.
dj-wtpd.l4: Today's lost and found: one mitten, and one opinion. Call the station. W T P D.
dj-wtpd.l5: The bridge is open, the mills are quiet, and the afternoon is long. Stay tuned, and stay warm-ish.
dj-wtpd.l6: Tepid Falls is proud to report that nothing happened today. W T P D, six-ten A M.
dj-wtpd.l7: This hour of the afternoon is brought to you by a nap. W T P D, the lukewarm sound of Tepid Falls.
dj-wtpd.l8: Up next, a little more organ, and a little less everything else. Six-ten A M.

dj-carols.i0: W J N G L, one twenty-two point five. All carols, all season.
dj-carols.i1: You are listening to the Christmas station. It is the only thing we play.
dj-carols.l2: That was a carol. The next one is also a carol. We checked the schedule.
dj-carols.l3: The Harbor Patrol reminds you that tinsel is not a seatbelt. W J N G L.
dj-carols.l4: Seasonal reminder: the fruitcake is still in the lobby. Nobody knows for how long. Happy holidays.
dj-carols.l5: Merry whatever you are having. You are listening to W J N G L, one twenty-two point five.
dj-carols.l6: The reindeer are on a break. The carols are not. W J N G L.
dj-carols.l7: Please do not hum along on the mic. You are not on the mic. Keep humming. W J N G L.
dj-carols.l8: Fun fact, there are four hundred verses to that one, and we are playing none of them. W J N G L.

ads.speedscan: Are you a car? Do you move? SpeedScan wants to know exactly how fast. Every ticket comes with a free green aroma. SpeedScan. We see you. We smell you. Terms apply.
ads.pardons: Pardon me, but have you seen Pardon's Surplus and Salvage? We have things. Lots of things. Some of them are even yours. Pardon's. Out past the dump. Ask for no one.
ads.dithers: Dithers College. Where tomorrow's decisions are made, eventually. Apply now. Or later. Or when you are ready. Dithers College. Established whenever.
ads.derby: Saturday, at Flounder Field: the demolition derby! Bring a car. Take home a different car. Tickets are free, because the insurance is not. Flounder Field, where cars go to compare notes!
ads.freshcoat: Is your getaway car the wrong color? Fresh Coat will respray it while you wait. No questions. No forms. No names. Fresh Coat. Look like a different problem.
ads.gus: Gus's Arcade, on Strand Boulevard. The games are fair. The quarters are not. High scores are forever. So are the quarters. Gus's Arcade.
ads.patrol: This is a public message from the Harbor Patrol. Please file form twelve-B before you are asked to. It saves everyone time, and it saves us a pen.
ads.dock7: Dock Seven Freight. If it is heavy, we lift it. If it is light, we also lift it, but more slowly. Dock Seven, on Ironbound Avenue. Not responsible.
ads.laundromat: The Spin Cycle Laundromat. We wash everything but the evidence. Open late, closed early, and always slightly damp. The Spin Cycle: your socks are in good hands. Probably.
ads.tepid: Come to Tepid Falls. The falls are sort of falling. The lukewarm waters await. Tepid Falls: just a short bridge away, and then a longer bridge.
ads.lighthouse: The Port Calamity Lighthouse. Climb four hundred steps, for a view of more steps. Open daily. Closed whenever the keeper is not feeling it.
ads.duck: The giant rubber duck in the harbor would like you to know that it is not a buoy. Please stop asking. Thank you. This message was paid for by the duck.
ads.boatyard: The Port Calamity Boatyard. We fix what floats, we float what is fixed, and we do not discuss the rest. Open six days. The seventh is for the tide.
ads.bakery: Wake up to Calamity Crumbs. Our bread is fresh until noon, and technically bread after that. Calamity Crumbs, on the corner, by the other corner.
ads.towing: Parked in the wrong place? So was your car. Harbor Tow and Tidy will take it somewhere worse, fast. Harbor Tow and Tidy. We found it before you lost it.
ads.notary: Need something stamped? Please see the Tepid Falls Notary, open weekdays, and sometimes the weekday after. We will stamp it, then we will stamp the stamp.

police.m01: Pull over, citizen. Form twelve-B is overdue.
police.m02: This is the Harbor Patrol. You are being asked, politely, to stop.
police.m03: Please stop the vehicle. We have a clipboard, and we are not afraid to use it.
police.m04: Driver of the vehicle, you are in violation of at least four ordinances. We will pick one later.
police.m05: Citizen, your registration is for a different, smaller car.
police.m06: Pull over and we will waive the paperwork. We will not waive the paperwork. Pull over anyway.
police.m07: Slow down. The speed limit is a suggestion we strongly suggest.
police.m08: Stop the car. Please. Our shift ends in ten minutes.
police.m09: This is a courtesy announcement. The courtesy is running out.
police.m10: Driver, you may remain seated, but the vehicle must stop.
police.m11: You are being followed by the law. Please act surprised.
police.m12: Please pull over. We brought snacks. They are for us.
police.m13: Attention, vehicle. This chase has been approved by the committee.
police.m14: Sir or madam, you have been issued a citation by default.
police.m15: Vehicle, the speed you are going is a number we did not approve.
police.m16: Please pull over. The paperwork is waiting, and it is very patient.
police.m17: Citizen, we are legally required to say this three times. Pull over. Pull over. Pull over.
police.s01: Attention, citizen. We are in the area. Please come forward. Or stay put. We will find you.
police.s02: We know you are out there. Come out, and we will validate your parking.
police.s03: Nobody move. We have lost somebody, and we would like them back.
police.c01: Unit four, suspect is heading toward the harbor. Or the other harbor.
police.c02: Dispatch, suspect is speeding. And turning. And also speeding.
police.c03: All units, be advised: the suspect is a car.
police.c04: Roger. Requesting backup, and a sandwich. In either order.
police.c05: Copy. Suspect has failed to file form twelve-B. Proceeding with enthusiasm.
police.c06: Dispatch, we have lost visual. Wait. There. No, that's a bush.
police.c07: All units, remember: no sirens in the library zone. We are not in the library zone.
police.c08: Suspect vehicle is described as, ah, fast.
police.c09: Ten-four. Eleven-seven. Twelve-B. Whatever the next one is.

dj-claudefm.i0: This is Claude FM. Smooth tunes for the long way home.
dj-claudefm.i1: Claude FM. Live around the clock, and mostly awake.
dj-claudefm.i2: You're tuned to Claude FM. Eyes on the road, one hand on the dial.
dj-claudefm.i3: Claude FM, the station that never signs off. We tried. The button is stuck.
dj-claudefm.i4: Claude FM. Thoughtful music for questionable parking.
dj-claudefm.l0: It's a fine night for a drive in Port Calamity. The harbor is wet, the streets are mostly there, and we're right here with you.
dj-claudefm.l1: Weather update: it is weather. Back to the music.
dj-claudefm.l2: If the road ahead turns into a lake, that is the harbor. Please do not drive into the harbor. Your car, and our lawyers, thank you.
dj-claudefm.l3: Feel like a change? Press T to turn the dial. We'll be here when you get back. We are always here.
dj-claudefm.l4: Too loud, or too soft? The music slider in Settings controls this station. We promise not to take it personally.
dj-claudefm.l5: That's the broadcast, the whole broadcast, and nothing but the broadcast. More tunes in a moment.
dj-claudefm.l6: Drive safe out there, Port Calamity. And if you do find yourself in the water, don't stop swimming.
dj-claudefm.t0: Need to say something, and your hands are full? Hold Y for quick chat, and pick a phrase from the wheel. Friendly, fast, and nobody has to type a thing.
dj-claudefm.t1: Did you know the Budget Line runs on real rails? Walk up to the locomotive, press F, and take the controls. The timetable is more of a suggestion.
dj-claudefm.t2: Out at SpeedScan Headquarters, the lifts will take you up, floor by floor. Bring a good attitude, and your visitor badge. Well, mostly the attitude.
dj-claudefm.t3: When the holiday season rolls around, somebody hides twenty-five presents in the front yards of town. Walk into one to find it, and see where you rank on the town leaderboard.
dj-claudefm.t4: When there's snow on the ground, press X to throw a snowball. Aim for your friends. Maybe not the bus.
dj-claudefm.t5: Why drive, when you can sail? Climb aboard a boat as a passenger, and watch the harbor go by. Hold on to your hat.
dj-claudefm.t6: The stunt park is open for business. Ramps, jumps, and absolutely no refunds on your suspension.
dj-claudefm.t7: Derby night at Flounder Field. Last car running wins. Bring a car you can bear to part with.
dj-claudefm.t8: Feeling quick? Line up for a street race, and find out who really owns the road. Spoiler: whoever brakes in time.
dj-claudefm.t9: Press G to buy a box of fireworks, then L to light them. Stand back, enjoy the show, and keep the pets indoors.
dj-claudefm.t10: Press O for photo mode. Frame the shot, find the light, and catch the town at its most flattering. Which is sunset.
dj-claudefm.t11: Hold N for the emote wheel. A wave, a dance, a shrug. It's how folks in Port Calamity say hello without saying anything at all.
dj-claudefm.t12: Stop by the wardrobe, and try on something new. You can look like yourself, or like someone much more interesting.
dj-claudefm.t13: Playing with the little ones? Switch on kid-friendly mode in Settings. A gentler town, and the same great music.
dj-claudefm.t14: Dithers College is open for visitors. The campus is lovely, the hill is steep, and the library is always quiet.
dj-claudefm.t15: Pardon's Surplus and Salvage. If it fell off something, it's in there. Everything must go, again.
